BioEnrollmentUI/Face/CompletePageBody/Te: Use your face the next time you want to unlock your device.
BioEnrollmentUI/Face/CompletePageRepeatI: Tip: If you wore glasses while setting up face recognition, select Improve recognition to go through the setup again without them. This will help us recognize you either way.
BioEnrollmentUI/Face/ErrorPageInstructio: Close Windows Hello, and then try going through the setup again.
Couldn’t turn on the camera. Make sure it’s working properly.
Camera is currently in use by another app. Close the app and try again.
It looks like you’ve already set up Windows Hello on another account. Remove face recognition from your other account, and then try again.
BioEnrollmentUI/Face/PinRequiredPageBody: Create a PIN to use if face recognition is not available. You may never need it, but it will serve as a backup just in case.
Once you set up your PIN, you will be able to sign in with your face.
BioEnrollmentUI/Face/RetailCleanupPageHe: All set! Give it a spin.
BioEnrollmentUI/Face/RetailDemoNamePageH: What would you like to be called?
BioEnrollmentUI/Face/RetailDemoWelcomePa: Your device recognizes you almost instantly using your face or fingerprint.
Any biometric data used in this demo will be encrypted, then deleted after two minutes of inactivity.
BioEnrollmentUI/Face/WelcomePageBody/Tex: Your device just got more personal. Start using your face to unlock your device, verify your identity, and buy things in the Store.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceCapturingText: Keep looking directly at your camera.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceDetectingErrorText: We couldn’t detect your face, please make sure there is enough light and your face is centered in the frame.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceEnrollCompleteText: Well done! You are ready to start using Windows Hello!
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceErrorFaceOccludedTex: We’re having trouble seeing you. Try removing anything that may be blocking your face.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceErrorPoorQualityText: Your device couldn’t detect you. Make sure your camera lens is clean.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceErrorTooBrightText: Too bright! Turns off some lights or go inside.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceErrorTooCloseText: Too close! Move a little farther away.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceErrorTooDarkText: Too dark! Turn on some lights or move somewhere brighter.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceErrorTooFarText: Too far! Move a bit closer.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceGuidanceStartText: Keep looking forward, facing the camera.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceMoveBackwardText: Move further away from the camera.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceNotDetectedText: Make sure your face is centered in the frame.
BioEnrollmentUI/FaceTooManyFacesText: More than one face detected. Only one person at a time can go through the setup.
BioEnrollmentUI/Fingerprint/CompletePage: Use your fingerprint the next time you want to unlock your device.
BioEnrollmentUI/Fingerprint/PinRequiredP: Create a PIN to use if fingerprint recognition is not available. You may never need it, but it will serve as a backup just in case.
Once you set up your PIN, you will be able to sign in with your fingerprint.
BioEnrollmentUI/Fingerprint/WelcomePageB: Your device just got more personal. Say goodbye to entering complex passwords and start using your fingerprint to unlock your device, verify your identity, and buy things in the Store.
BioEnrollmentUI/Iris/CompletePageBody/Te: Use your eyes the next time you want to unlock your device.
BioEnrollmentUI/Iris/CompletePageRepeatI: Tip: If you wore glasses while setting up Windows Hello, select Improve recognition to go through the setup again without them. This will help us recognize you either way.
BioEnrollmentUI/Iris/ErrorPageInstructio: Close Windows Hello, and then try going through the setup again.
BioEnrollmentUI/Iris/PinRequiredPageBody: Create a PIN to use if eye recognition is not available. You may never need it, but it will serve as a backup just in case.
Once you set up your PIN, you will be able to sign in with your eyes.
BioEnrollmentUI/Iris/TutorialPageInstruc: Hold your phone in front of your eyes, and then select Next to continue.
BioEnrollmentUI/Iris/WelcomePageBody/Tex: Your device just got more personal. Say goodbye to entering complex passwords and start using Windows Hello to unlock your device, verify your identity, and buy things in the Store using your eyes.
BioEnrollmentUI/IrisCaptureBodyTextDeskt: Slowly move closer until your eyes touch the edges of the frame.
BioEnrollmentUI/IrisCaptureBodyTextMobil: Hold your phone directly in front of your eyes and make sure both eyes are visible on the screen.
BioEnrollmentUI/IrisRotationInstructionT: Rotate your device so the camera is at the top.
BioEnrollmentUI/SecurityKey/FingerprintC: Use your fingerprint the next time you want to unlock your device.
BioEnrollmentUI/SecurityKey/FingerprintR: You will need to set up a PIN for your security key before a fingerprint can be set up
BioEnrollmentUI/SecurityKey/PinBlocked/T: You’ve entered incorrect PINs too many times. Use a different sign-in option, or contact your IT support person.
BioEnrollmentUI/SecurityKey/PinDescripti: Creating a PIN for your security key helps keep you secure
BioEnrollmentUI/SecurityKey/ResetError/T: Could not complete security key reset.
BioEnrollmentUI/SecurityKey/ResetKeyDesc: Remove everything from this security key and reset to factory settings
BioEnrollmentUI/SecurityKey/ResetKeyFull: The security key will be reset to factory settings. All data and credentials on this key will be cleared.
BioEnrollmentUI/SecurityKey/SetUpPinText: Set up a security key PIN
